Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. A big, fast bird flew down and took some wheat. Tim and his dad were surprised. They did not know that could happen. The bird was very smart.
Tim and his dad watched the bird fly away with the wheat. They smiled and said, "That bird must really like our wheat!" From that day on, they always shared some wheat with the birds.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. Her name was Sarah and she lived in a small town. Every day she had lots of fun playing with the other kids.
But one day something changed. There was a new worry in the town. Something that made Sarah very alert. She started to watch and listen very carefully but she couldn't figure out what was going on.
When she asked her mommy and daddy, they said there was nothing to be worried about. But Sarah was still careful and did what her parents said.
The next day the people in the town were happy and everything seemed back to normal. Sarah was so relieved and played with her friends all day.
That night, Sarah had sweet dreams and was no longer worried. She knew that as long as she stayed alert, everything would be ok.

Once upon a time, there was a messy room. In the room, there was a big mirror. A little girl named Lily lived in this room. One day, Lily's mom told her to clean her room. Lily did not want to clean, but she knew she had to. Her mom said they could go to the park after she cleaned.
Lily started to clean her room. She put her toys away and made her bed. She looked in the mirror and saw her messy hair. She thought about how fun the park would be, and she knew she had to finish cleaning first. She brushed her hair in front of the mirror and put on her shoes.
After cleaning her room and looking nice, Lily and her mom went to the park. Lily played on the swings and the slide. She was so happy she cleaned her room. The park was so much fun! When they went home, Lily looked in the mirror again and smiled. She knew that cleaning her room had made her mom happy, and going to the park was the best part of her day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to go to the park. The park was peaceful and had many trees. Tim's favorite thing to do was swing on the swings.
One sunny day, Tim met a girl named Sue at the park. Sue wanted to swing too. Tim said, "Hi! I am Tim. Do you want to swing with me?" Sue said, "Yes, I am Sue. Let's swing together!"
Tim and Sue swung high in the sky. They laughed and had fun. The sun was warm, and the park was peaceful. After swinging, they played with the ball and became good friends. From that day on, Tim and Sue always played together at the park.

Once upon a time there was a little lamb called Louise. Louise loved to hop, jump and run around the fields. Every day, Louise's owner, Melissa, would go to the fields and take care of Louise. Melissa would fill up a bucket of fresh water and wool for Louise to stay warm, and she would brush the red wool until it was soft.
One day, Melissa noticed that Louise had more wool on her back than usual. "Louise you have so much wool on your back now! What must I do to take care of it?", Melissa asked.
Louise smiled as she looked up at Melissa, who could see that Louise was still smiling even though her wool was so thick. Louise took a deep breath and said, "Don't worry! Please brush it, so that it stays soft and fluffy."
Melissa was so proud of Louise and the way she remembered to take care of her own wool. She gave Louise a big hug and promised to always take care of Louise.
The moral of the story is that taking care of yourself is important. Even when things may seem difficult, it's important to remember to take care and look after yourself.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Amber. She was three years old and was very curious about everything.
One day, Amber asked her parents what marriage is. Her father froze in surprise before starting to explain.
"Marriage is when two people love each other very much and decide to join their lives together, which means that their family will become one family," he said.
Amber then asked if she can get married when she grows up. Her parents were shocked and asked her why she wanted to get married.
Amber looked guilty and said nothing. After a long silence, she started to talk.
"I want to get married in order to be able to make my own family. So that I can have someone who loves me and someone to love back," she said.
Her parents were so moved by her words that they hugged her tight. They both promised to never let Amber feel alone and to always love her, no matter what.

Once upon a time, there was a little chair. It was a useful chair. Many people would sit on it and sigh. They felt happy when they sat on the chair. The chair had a big friend, the tree. They lived in a nice park.
One day, a big storm came. The tree told the chair, "I will keep you safe." The chair was scared but trusted the tree. The tree was very strong. The storm made a lot of noise, and the wind blew hard.
But the storm was too strong. The tree tried to hold on, but it fell down. The chair was very sad. The tree could not help the chair anymore. People came and took the tree away. The chair was all alone, and nobody sat on it again.

Once upon a time there was a 3 year old girl. She loved colouring and drawing. One day, she asked her mummy if she could print her picture. Her mummy said yes and she went to get the special printing machine.
The girl was so excited and quickly started to print her picture. Suddenly, the printing machine ran out of juice and stopped working. The girl was very confused and didn't know what to do.
She went to her mummy and asked: "Mummy, why did it stop printing? What can I do?". Her mummy replied: "Don't worry sweetheart. All you have to do is put more juice in the machine and it will start printing again".
So the 3 year old girl went back to the printing machine and put more juice in it. Then, her picture started printing and she was very happy. She showed her mummy the printed picture and was so proud of her work.

Once upon a time, there was a little blue bird named Tim. Tim liked to use his wings to fly high in the sky. One day, Tim saw a big tree with a lot of steps going up.
Tim met a squirrel on the first step. The squirrel said, "Hi, Tim! Do you want to play with me?" Tim said, "Yes! Let's go up the steps together." So, they went up the steps, one by one.
At the top of the tree, Tim and the squirrel found a big, blue ball. They played with the ball and had lots of fun. Then, they went back down the steps and said goodbye. Tim flew away, happy to have a new friend.

One day, a little rat went for a walk. He was a grumpy rat and did not like to play with others. As he walked, he saw a big tree with a hole in it. He thought it would be a fun place to hide.
As the grumpy rat went inside the hole, he found a big, soft ball. He poked it with his little paw and said, "Hey, who are you?" To his surprise, the ball spoke back, "I am a big, soft ball. I am sad because no one wants to play with me."
The grumpy rat thought for a moment and then said, "I am grumpy and no one wants to play with me, too. Let's be friends and play together!" The big, soft ball was so happy and they played all day. The grumpy rat was not grumpy anymore, and they became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot had a long tail. He liked to wag his tail when he was happy. One day, Spot saw a rare butterfly. The butterfly was pretty and had many colors.
Spot said, "I hope we can be friends!" The butterfly said, "Yes, let's be friends!" They played together in the sun. Spot wagged his tail, and the butterfly flew around him.
After a while, it was time for the butterfly to go. Spot was sad, but he knew that they would see each other again. Spot wagged his tail and said, "Bye, friend!" The butterfly said, "Bye, Spot!" Then, the butterfly flew away, and Spot went home.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was very shy and often felt ashamed.
One day, the girl found a key. She was excited and held it in her hand.
But then, the girl realized that the key was special. With it, she could restore things.
So, the girl went on a journey. She used the key to restore things that made her feel happy and brave.
In the end, the girl was no longer shy or ashamed. She had restored her courage and was now filled with joy.

One day, a girl named Mia found a key. It was not a normal key. It was big and shiny. Mia wanted to know what the key could open. She looked all around her house but did not find anything.
Mia went outside and saw a big box. She thought the key might open it. She put the key in the box and turned it. The box opened and revealed a big, colorful ball. Mia was very happy and started to play with the ball.
But then, something unexpected happened. The ball started to bounce by itself! It bounced higher and higher. Mia was surprised. The ball was not just a normal ball. It was a magic bouncing ball! Mia had lots of fun playing with her new magic ball.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to go to the office with his owner, Sam. Every day, they went to the office together.
One day, Sam told Buddy, "I have to give a big talk in front of many people. I am very scared." Buddy wagged his tail and looked at Sam. Sam knew Buddy would stay by his side no matter what.
The day of the big talk came. Sam was very nervous, but Buddy was there. As Sam started to speak, Buddy sat by his feet. When Sam finished, everyone in the office started to applaud. They clapped their hands and cheered. Buddy barked and wagged his tail, happy that his owner did a great job.
After the big talk, Sam looked at Buddy and said, "Thank you for being with me. You are the best loyal friend I could ever have." Buddy barked and licked Sam's face, showing his love.
From that day on, Sam and Buddy were even closer. They went to the office together every day, and Sam was never scared again.

The sun was peeking over the trees and Peter curiously ran to the window to watch as the colours of the morning bloomed. He wondered what exciting things the day had in store for him, and he smiled his silly little smile.
Arriving in the living room, he noticed something new - there was a big, beautiful fireplace. He ran over and started to touch it. His mom called him over, and said, “It looks so special, what do you think it can do?”
Peter said, “Maybe it can give us silly heat!” His mom laughed and said, “That’s not exactly how it works, but it can give off warmth!”
Peter smiled and said, “Let’s make a fire and get silly and warm!” His mom lit a fire, and the two of them snuggled up together in front of the fireplace and watched the flames dance and bloom.

Ben and Mia like to play with the machine. The machine has many buttons and lights. It makes funny noises and shows pictures. Ben and Mia do not know what the machine does, but they have fun.
One day, Ben and Mia find a new button on the machine. It is red and shiny. Ben wants to use the button. He says to Mia, "Look, a new button! Let me use it!"
Mia says, "No, Ben, do not use it! It might be bad!"
But Ben does not listen. He pushes the button hard. The machine makes a loud beep and a flash. Then it stops. All the buttons and lights go off. The machine is broken.
Ben and Mia are scared. They try to turn on the machine, but nothing happens. They cry and call for mom and dad. Mom and dad come and see the broken machine. They are angry and sad. They say to Ben and Mia, "What did you do? You broke the machine! It was very expensive and important! You are in big trouble!"
Ben and Mia are sorry and ashamed. They wish they did not use the button. They hug mom and dad and say, "We are sorry, we did not know. Please fix the machine!"
But mom and dad say, "We cannot fix the machine. It is too damaged. You have to live without it. Maybe you will learn to be careful and listen next time."
Ben and Mia are frustrated and sad. They have no machine to play with. They have no fun. They have a bad day.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily loved to paint. She had a big box of paint and many brushes. Lily also had a mitten that she wore when it was cold outside.
One day, Lily was painting a picture of her mitten. She painted and painted until she was tired. She went to bed, leaving her painting to dry. That night, something unexpected happened. The mitten in the painting came to life!
The mitten felt helpless because it was all alone. It jumped out of the painting and went outside to look for a friend. It found a kitten who was cold and shivering. The mitten jumped onto the kitten's paw to keep it warm. The kitten was so happy that it started to purr. When Lily woke up, she saw the mitten and kitten playing together. From that day on, Lily, the mitten, and the kitten were best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a purple top that she loved very much. The top was soft and pretty. Lily wore it all the time.
One day, Lily's mom told her that they needed to sell some old clothes. Lily did not want to sell her purple top. But her mom said, "We need to make room for new clothes."
Lily was sad, but she knew her mom was right. They went to a place where people sell things. Lots of people came to look at the clothes. A little boy saw the purple top and his eyes got big. He liked it a lot.
Lily saw that the little boy was happy. She felt better about selling her purple top. She knew that the top would make the little boy happy, just like it made her happy. And now, there would be room for new clothes in her closet.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely room. In this room, there were many toys. Two little kids, Tom and Sue, loved to play there. They had lots of fun with their toys.
One day, Tom and Sue found a big toy car. They both wanted to play with it. At first, they did not know what to do. Then, Tom had an idea. He said, "Let's share the toy car!"
So, Tom and Sue shared the toy car. They took turns playing with it. They had so much fun in the lovely room. They learned that sharing was a good thing. And from that day, they always shared their toys and had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a mysterious tree. The tree had many big roots. A little girl named Lucy liked to play near the tree every day.
One day, Lucy saw a tiny door on the tree. She opened the door and found a small room inside. Lucy went in and saw many toys. She picked up a toy and started to play. She was very happy.
But then, Lucy heard her mom calling her. She ran out of the tree and went home. The next day, Lucy went back to the tree to play with the toys. But she missed the tiny door. She looked and looked, but she could not find it. The mysterious tree had hidden the door. Lucy was sad, but she still played near the tree every day, hoping the door would come back.

Once upon a time, there was a big, friendly dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball all day. He would run, jump, and keep the ball close to him. Max was very happy when he played with his ball.
One day, Max met a little girl named Lily. Lily was a nice girl who knew a magic spell. She wanted to help Max have even more fun. So, she said the spell, and Max's ball became even bigger! Max was very excited to play with his big ball.
Max and Lily played together with the big ball every day. They would roll it, bounce it, and keep it close to them. They were very happy and became the best of friends. And Max knew that, with Lily and her magic spell, they would always have fun together.

Lily was very happy. It was her birthday. She had a big cake with pink frosting and four candles. She had many friends to play with. She had balloons and toys and games.
She wanted to open her presents. She saw a big box with a bow. She thought it was a doll. She loved dolls. She ran to the box and tore the paper. She opened the box and screamed.
Inside the box was a thick book. It had many words and pictures. It was a book about animals. Lily did not like books. She liked dolls. She was very angry and sad.
"Why did you give me a book?" she cried to her mom. "I wanted a doll!"
Her mom hugged her and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. I thought you would like to learn about animals. They are very interesting and fun. You can read the book with me or with your friends. Maybe you will like it."
Lily shook her head and threw the book on the floor. She did not want to read. She wanted to play. She wanted a doll. She did not have a happy birthday.

Once upon a time, there was a farm with many animals. The animals liked to play and have fun. One day, a little dog named Max came to the farm. Max wanted to play with the animals, but he was very small.
"Stay safe, Max," said the big cow. "The farm can be a big place for a little dog like you." Max listened and stayed close to the cow. They played together and had fun.
One day, while they were playing, they heard a loud noise. The other animals were scared, but Max was brave. He went to see what it was. It was a big machine that was lost. Max barked and showed the machine the way out of the farm. The animals were so happy and thanked Max for keeping them safe. From that day on, Max was a hero on the farm and everyone loved him.

Tim and Sam were playing in the woods. They liked to pretend they were animals and run and hide. Tim was a deer and Sam was a hunter. Sam had a stick for a gun and a hat for a cap.
"Bang! Bang!" Sam shouted, pointing his stick at Tim. "I got you, deer! You have to surrender!"
Tim shook his head and ran away. He did not want to surrender. He wanted to keep playing. He ran behind a big tree and waited for Sam to find him.
Sam looked around and saw the tree. He smiled and crept closer. He thought he had Tim trapped. He was ready to shoot again.
But Tim had a plan. He saw a dry branch on the ground. He picked it up and threw it to the other side of the tree. It made a loud noise.
Sam heard the noise and turned his head. He thought Tim was there. He ran to the other side of the tree, leaving his stick behind.
Tim saw his chance. He jumped out of his hiding place and grabbed Sam's stick. He pointed it at Sam and shouted, "Bang! Bang! Now I got you, hunter! You have to surrender!"
Sam was surprised and laughed. He put his hands up and said, "OK, OK, you got me, deer! You are very smart and fast. I surrender!"
Tim and Sam hugged and smiled. They were happy. They liked to play together. They decided to switch roles and play again.

Once upon a time, there were two brothers. Alex was the older brother and John was the younger brother. One day, Alex saw an automobile that he wanted to buy. The automobile was very tight and looked like it was in good condition. Alex asked his brother if he could borrow the money to buy the automobile, but John said no. Alex was very unhappy, but he understood why John said no.
John had learned to value money, and he knew automobiles could break down easily. He wanted Alex to save his money and spend it on things that he really needed. Alex thanked his brother and promised to remember the lesson of valuing his money.
The brothers worked hard and saved their money. Eventually, Alex was able to buy the automobile he wanted without having to borrow money from his brother. He valued his money and appreciated having a car, but he never forgot the valuable lesson his brother had taught him.

One day, a cheerful boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big sand area. He wanted to play in the sand. He took his toy truck and started to dig.
A little girl named Lily was playing there too. She had a toy shovel and a bucket. "Hi, do you want to play with me?" Lily asked Tim. Tim said, "Yes! Let's build a sand castle!"
Tim and Lily worked together to make a big sand castle. They used the shovel and bucket to move the sand. They made towers and walls. They were very happy.
A small dog came to the park. It saw Tim and Lily's sand castle. The dog wanted to play too. It ran to the castle and started to dig. The sand castle was falling down.
Tim and Lily were sad. But then, they had an idea. They would lead the dog away from the sand castle. They took a ball and threw it. The dog ran after the ball. Tim and Lily saved their castle and played all day.

Once upon a time, there was a family who liked to travel around in their car. One day, they decided to drive far away, but they did not have enough gas. So, they asked for support from their neighbour, who gave them some gas from their tank.
The family thanked them and got in their car. They started to drive away, but after a few minutes, the car stopped. They looked in the tank, and saw that it was empty! They had no gas and were stuck in the middle of nowhere.
The family had to ask for help to get back home. Unfortunately, no one was around to support them. They had to walk for days until they finally reached home. They had learnt their lesson, and never asked for help again!
